mostWorthwhile.text: Making different songs from island life and variation was worthwhile: it connected geographic separation to divergence while distinguishing inherited changes from learned traditions.

leastWorthwhile.text: The first two guesses were less satisfying: the automatic alternatives advanced the story, but the required order was not initially clear.

surprise.text: Birds needed a mountain range before seasons could produce migration; the latter was my original guess.

arbitrary.text: The mountain range producing far-ranging birds felt somewhat arbitrary without an explanation of the connection.
